profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Tesla | Ex-Amazon
profile.summary:
My passion for Software engineering comes from the fact that software technologies can impact and improve people's daily lives with minimal friction to adapt, and learning to become one will bring me opportunities to improve myself and bring a closer goal to turn people's lifecycle interaction into automation. 

With 3 years experience in both Software Engineer/ Full Stack Developer working on high-scalability, large scale projects for more than 1M+ customers from start-ups to multination technology companies, I am engaging in solve business problems and technologies revolving around cloud architectural, micro-services, distributed file system and scaling services and seeking for mid-level entry positions in resolve around the aforementioned technologies.  

Small tips about myself: I love spending times to read software engineer, dev ops books in every morning and always spending more than 20 hours a week to improve myself from other peoples, online course or any changes.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
•  Spearheaded design and rollout of Delivery & Registration applications across 673 global service centers, supporting 2M+ annual vehicle deliveries and reducing delivery times by 70% with Azure, Go, C#, and Kubernetes.
•  Architected migration from GraphQL Federation to ElasticSearch, cutting query latency by 92%
•  Drove observability strategy with Splunk / Grafana, enabling zero-downtime deployments and sustaining 99% SLA uptime.
•  Owned mobile delivery execution service, streamlining workflows for 33% of internal users using GoLang, Kafka, MySQL and Elasticsearch.
•  Designed and operationalized automated advisor assignment system leveraging RabbitMQ, MSSQL, reducing delivery process time by 10% and standardizing assignment across global regions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•   Owned Go/Java based AWS CloudWatch Agent, powering observability for 1M+ customers and 6M+ Amazon instances.
•   Delivered OpenTelemetry-based agent with unified traces/logs/metrics, piloted with 50 enterprise customers.
•   Built and launched real-time performance dashboard (React, DynamoDB, Lambda, Github Actions), providing 1M+ customers visibility into release resource usage and accelerating troubleshooting.
•   Drove automation of 66% of the E2E testing pipeline across multi-OS and containerized environments with Terraform, Go, and GitHub Actions, significantly improving release velocity
•   Optimized agent performance by 90% (Go Profiler), lower overhead for customers monitoring 10K+ Prometheus metrics.
•   Led knowledge-sharing sessions for 16 engineers, lowering ticket volume by 10% and raising overall team expertise.
•   Owned roll-back automation system for CloudWatch Agent releases, improving resiliency and customer trust.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•  Revamped hiring interview platform with vision intelligence, adopted by five enterprise customers using React, Redis, TypeScript, WebRTC, MongoDB, OAuth, and Docker.
•   Led development of a fintech dashboard for 20K+ daily trading account openings, used by executive leadership.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: •  Contributed to a school management platform (React, Redux, JS) improving teacher and student experience.

positions.title: Finance Club Member
positions.description:
• Managed and organized events that encourage entrepreneurship in student
• Organize and operate a small event of selling products, a total of approximately 2 million.
• Organized budget documentation and tracked expenses to maintain tight business controls
• Called, dealt and made the contract with sponsors
• Summarized and managed the prize 1.8 billion VND in FLAGUP- Face the Race

projects.title: Train Ticket Management System
projects.description:
- Designed and analyzed ER - diagram to ensure consistency and integrity of information stored in the database.
- Programmed server-side system rendering system with Java and Tomcat server on Amazon EC2
- Integrated MySQL on Amazon RDS to retrieve, edit and add appropriate data based on the user's role.

projects.title: Zoom Bot
projects.description:
- Integrated PyAutoGui library to create a Bot that can automatically sign in to Zoom in a predefined time.
- Handled ZoomAPI to get information regarding the assigned room and use Bot to record each participant’s voice.
